scope: Source-bottle-inpainted EPIC Ego controls using a GrabCut foreground matte
summary: The control state contract passed, but the bottle matte included a dark rectangular counter patch that H3 copied into its first generated pour frame.
evidence: All outputs decoded, trajectories were explicit, and the minimum pairwise state RMS was 113.5120 pixels.
The control contact sheet and the generated pour midframe both show the rectangular dark patch adjacent to the controlled bottle.
lessons: A segmentation matte can satisfy trajectory metrics while injecting a highly learnable background artifact; alpha support needs direct visual inspection.
limitations: The first formal H3 attempt based on these controls is invalid and was stopped early.
next_actions: Use a blue-foreground HSV matte that excludes dark counter pixels, rebuild every window, and restart in a new experiment directory.
